content: >I just want to hold this boy's hand, bros. Not even, like, *him* specifically, just ANY dude's hand. I wanna hold a boy's hand in the HALL, man. And just BE there. Lined up against the walls of PUBLIC REJECTION. Ostracized. "Muh feelings!" they'll cry. Why the FUCK does ANYONE even care?! Why do they HATE US for LOVING?! It's so goddamn IRONIC. ABSOLUTELY obliterated the second I step out of this CAGE. I wanna be a cute girly boy, holy shit. SO WHAT? WHAT'S WRONG WITH IT?!
